name: Jennifer J. Payseno
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: A partner at McKinley Irvin, Jennifer J. Payseno focuses her practice exclusively on family law. Located in the firm's office in Seattle, Washington, she represents clients throughout the state in matters involving divorce, asset valuation and division, child custody and support issues, contested relocations, and post-decree modifications.

Ms. Payseno is a leader in the legal community. She served as President of the King County Bar Association 2019-2020. She is also a member of the King County Judicial Screening committee, serving as its chair in 2009-2010.

Over the course of her legal career, Ms. Payseno has received numerous awards and honors. She has received a certificate of appreciation from the Housing Justice Project of the King County Bar Association for her contributions, and she is also a previous recipient of the Random Acts of Professionalism Award given by the Washington State Bar Association. Ms. Payseno's excellent reputation among her fellow professionals is further evidenced by her listing in Best Lawyers of America and Super Lawyers. Frequently sharing her knowledge and experience with others, she has delivered presentations on family law topics to continuing legal education programs of the Washington State and Tacoma-Pierce County bar associations, and she has also written articles for Seattle Business magazine, 425 Business magazine, and the KCBA Bar Bulletin.
